data_limitations: MSFT files net sales on us-gaap:Revenues until FY2010 and on us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet from FY2009 to the FY2018 third-quarter 10-Q, and on us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax from the FY2018 10-K, which states FY2016 and FY2017 on it as comparatives. The core registry accepts the successor as an exact identity mapping from 2017-09-30, holds no mapping for us-gaap:Revenues, and maps us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet only partially, which is not accepted as a source. This role reads the one element with a clear semantic basis and names what it reads, rather than falling back to a broader or unaccepted element to lengthen the sample.

Cover-page shares outstanding, taken as filed and never adjusted for a split, paired with the as-traded close. MSFT has no split in the price series's range: its last was the 2:1 of February 2003, before the series begins.

The capture's acceptance index covers the issuer's periodic filings only, so a fact first published in another form becomes knowable in this lane at the next periodic filing that carries it. The lane therefore never uses a value before it was public, and it may use a value later than it first became public.

formula.denominator: the trailing twelve months of MSFT's reported revenue, as four consecutive fiscal quarters
formula.expression: (as-traded close x cover-page shares outstanding) / TTM of us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
formula.numerator: as-traded close on the evaluation date times the latest knowable cover-page shares outstanding

distribution.metric_label: MSFT reported-revenue multiple (research): market capitalization over the trailing twelve months of MSFT's reported revenue

production_refusal.statement: No production reference is created from this distribution, and none may be created from it.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax to 'revenue' for MSFT as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, without a filer restriction, in force from 2017-09-30. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding.basis: The role names no registry metric, so the registry has no standing to rule on the element. The lane's own specification governs the role, and the element is read under it.

distribution.research_use_label: RESEARCH USE ONLY. This distribution is computed from filed evidence that the production qualification regime does not admit. It is not a valuation reference, it is not a production reference chain input, and it must not be presented as one.

unit_policy.scale_basis: MSFT states its amounts in units; the capture holds them unchanged and no scaling is applied.

observation_lineage: The committed summary carries one line per evaluation date. The full lineage -- every operand, accession, element, period, unit and usable date -- is regenerated exactly by the lane from the capture, whose files are hashed in the capture manifest.
